summary_en: 50,000,000 shares (4.3% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired; ¥140.0 billion upper limit; open-market purchases on TSE; 10 August through 31 December 2026. Stated reason: capital efficiency and shareholder return enhancement.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: INPEX Corporation's board of directors has authorised the acquisition of up to 50 million common shares, representing 4.3% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), with an upper expenditure limit of ¥140.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 10 August and 31 December 2026, in accordance with Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied by Article 165(3)). The stated purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 1,163,189,327 common shares outstanding (excluding treasury) and 95,946,740 treasury shares.
